resolved_conflicts.explanation: The summary page dates a primary lookout to the 1930s and its discontinuation to the 1940s. A 1944 newspaper item, as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, describes plans to place a fire lookout on the same mountain. The sources do not say whether the 1944 plan replaced the earlier lookout or was a different structure, so the story reports both without choosing.

notes_for_editor: Do not confuse with the Black Mountain lookout on the Sierra National Forest in Fresno County (NHLR; CCC-built 1934, still standing per NHLR snippet), a different site. Its Forest Lookouts page is black-mountain2.html. Archive.org item casbcfm_000740 (Black Mountain Lookout support structure) does not say which Black Mountain it shows, so it was not used. Record coordinates 36.3046, -120.40321 match the Wikipedia high point of Black Mountain (36.30444, -120.40333). Decade dates (1930, 1940) are approximations from the summary page, which gives only the decade. Spelling varies: the summary uses Murietta, the header and record use Murrieta.
